description: The chart illustrates CoLeG-R performance (in percent) for three LLaMA-2 model scales under four supervised fine-tuning (SFT) dataset conditions, shown as grouped bars for each model. The horizontal axis contains the model categories labeled, from left to right, “LLaMA-2-7B,” “LLaMA-2-13B,” and “LLaMA-2-70B,” while the vertical axis is labeled “CoLeG-R (%)” and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 up to the mid-80s, with regularly spaced tick marks every 10 percentage points. For each model group there are four adjacent bars corresponding to the legend: “no SFT” (light blue with diagonal hatch) is approximately 66% for LLaMA-2-7B, about 70% for LLaMA-2-13B, and about 81% for LLaMA-2-70B; “+ SFT on D₀” (light orange with horizontal hatch) is approximately 66% for 7B, about 74% for 13B, and about 82% for 70B; “+ SFT on D₀, D₁” (light purple with diagonal hatch) is about 81% for 7B, about 85% for 13B, and about 85% for 70B; and “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” (solid light pink) is about 84% for 7B, about 80% for 13B, and about 84% for 70B. The bars are arranged as side-by-side groups (not stacked), with the legend shown inside the plot area in the lower-right; no individual bars appear separately annotated or otherwise specially emphasized beyond their color and hatch styling.
